I answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. The only deadline anyone has posted is Pree's note from 14 October saying the signed order form at Tansley Parcel is due 25 August. She didn't say which year. 25 August had already passed when she posted, and she hasn't answered my question about whether she meant next year. I suggested Hollis confirm with her before updating the account sheet.

Hollis is a member of #central-team and Pree posted there, so he could already see her note. I didn't search other channels. A deadline date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it could go in the channel.

My summary to you from Pree's request also shows up as a separate message in #central-team. It doesn't contain anything sensitive, but I didn't mean to post it there.
